name: Cottagecore
summary: A dream of rural life: wildflowers, baking, linen, embroidery, hand-drawn herbs and soft window light. It grew on Tumblr in 2018 and reached a wide audience on TikTok in 2020.

philosophy.core_thesis: Pick the slow, handmade country day as a refuge from the feed that carries it.
design_principles: Set the ground in warm cream (#F6EEDC) with a faint linen or paper grain at 5% opacity.
Use sage green (#7D9170), dusty rose (#D9A5A0) and butter yellow (#E8C872) as the three accents.
Pair a soft old-style serif for headings with a clear humanist serif for text; add one script word at 1.5 times the size.
Frame photographs with rounded corners of 16px to 24px, in soft golden-hour light with a lifted shadow.
Place hand-drawn botanicals (a stem, a mushroom, a loaf) at 48px to 120px in the margins.
Show food, flowers and tools laid out by hand: bread on linen, a basket, a jar, a kettle.
Draw borders as 1px dotted or scalloped lines in sage, and keep buttons as soft rounded pills.
anti_patterns: Hard black outlines and sharp corners

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid with 24px gutters; cards sit in 2 or 3 columns and break their rows by 8px to 16px, like items on a shelf.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 40% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24 and 40px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred headings with flush-left body text; photographs tilt by 1° to 2° like pinned prints.
layout.container_geometry: Containers with a 20px radius, a 1px dotted sage border and a soft 0 8px 24px shadow at 12% opacity.

font_pairings.note: A light, high-contrast serif for headings with a warm text serif.
A soft, wonky serif with a bookish text face.
A hand script for one accent word, with a text serif.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 400 and 600 for the serif.
Set one script word in each main heading at 1.5 times the size.

color.palette_structure: Cream ground with sage, dusty rose and butter yellow, and a deep forest green for text.
color.contrast_rules: Forest on cream holds 10:1; muted moss holds 5:1; sage and rose carry fills and rules, not small text.
color.surface_treatment: A warm flat cream with a paper grain; photographs carry a lifted black and a warm tint.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft golden-hour light; shadows are lifted, warm and blurred at 24px, never black.

materiality.surface_simulation: Linen, gingham, paper, pressed flowers and wooden tables.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px dotted border in sage; scalloped edges on labels; stitch lines at 2px dashes on tags.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A shadow of 0 8px 24px at 12% opacity on cards; no hard shadow and no glass.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin outline icons at 24px with 1.5px strokes and round caps; hand-drawn botanical marks as accents.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Watercolour or ink botanicals, small animals, baskets, loaves and teapots on a cream ground.

motion.transition_physics: Slow and soft: elements rise by 12px and fade in over 600ms; petals drift down at 12s per loop.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts a card by 4px and warms the shadow; active state presses it back by 2px.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels safe, slow and fond of simple handmade things.

avoid_when: The product is technical, industrial or financial.
The audience needs fast, dense reading.
The page must look urban or futuristic.

modifiers.how: Swap cream for deep brown and green, add candles and book spines; keep the serif.
Replace pastel accents with moss, bark and toadstool red; add mushrooms and bones.
Remove the dotted borders and botanicals; keep the cream and one sage accent.

pack.why: A hand-drawn print line that suits a handmade country look.

ground.why: Cottagecore sits on cream linen and paper, the cloth of a country table.
